title: The lender container mounts the whole host home and every group's instances
foundBy: session agent, comparing the lender with another credential gateway

evidence.verified: go test ./internal/cli/ -count=1: TestTheLenderMountsOnlyWhatItReads and TestEnsureReplacesALenderWithOlderMounts PASS. With the narrowed mounts, `make test-agents-lent` on podman 5.8.7 ran 7 of 7 cells green. The full `make ci` gate on the four lender commits together exited 0, with 14 of 14 agent replay cells passing on podman. Unit tests alone cover the replacement of a box with the old mounts.

resolution: The lender mounts read-only just the directory each slot's credential lives in, plus its own group's directory. A directory is mounted rather than a file, because a credential is replaced by a rename. A lender created with the old mounts is replaced on the next create or start in its group (R150f).
details:
The lender box bind-mounts the agent login home, `$HOME` by default, and the whole instances root, both read-only. The lender reads only the credential files and its group's loans. Any bug that lets a sandbox read a file through the lender therefore exposes `~/.ssh`, the tier keys, and every group's loans and keys.

To see it, run `podman inspect cs-sandbox-net-lender --format '{{json .Mounts}}'` on a host with a lent sandbox.
